context.body: Selected for the reader trail because “A council decides that one man should die” preserves a distinct setup source unit within anticipation.

observations.body: Chief priests and Pharisees gather a council; Caiaphas argues that one person should die for the people, the narrator widens the statement, and from that day they plan Jesus’ death.
observations.label: A council decides that one man should die: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps chief priests and pharisees, caiaphas, council decision visible within its Crucifixion evidence.
